headline: Congress named a Winter Haven, Florida post office building after Althea Margaret Daily Mills.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 1401 1st Street North in Winter Haven, Florida. The building is now officially called the Althea Margaret Daily Mills Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office operates or what services it provides.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2020, and the designation took effect on that date.
